docs.title: API & Integration Documentation
docs.subtitle: Complete REST API Specifications, Request Parameters, Response Formats, and SDK Code Snippets

generate.title: Text-to-Image Generation (POST /api/generate)
generate.desc: Generate high-resolution images from natural language text descriptions using Google Gemini Imagen 3 engine.
generate.authNote: Authentication is optional for guest users (Free - 20 req/day). Include Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> for account quota.
generate.promptParam: Detailed description of the image to create (maximum 2,000 characters).
generate.sessionParam: Session ID (e.g. sess_...) to persist this message turn in conversation history.
generate.modelParam: Gemini AI model to execute generation: '3.7-flash' (2x quota), '3.5-flash-lite' (1x quota), '3.1-pro' (3x quota), 'extended-thinking' (4x quota).

edit.title: Image-to-Image Editing (POST /api/edit)
edit.desc: Modify, restyle, or replace elements in an attached image based on natural language instructions.
edit.authNote: Image editing capability requires plans with allowImageEditing enabled (such as Pro & Ultra).
edit.promptParam: Text instructions specifying what changes or additions should be made to the image.
edit.imageParam: Input image data in Base64 Data URL format ('data:image/png;base64,...') or public image URL.
edit.sessionParam: Session ID to continue editing within the existing image history chain.
edit.aspectRatioParam: New aspect ratio if resizing the output image.
edit.modelParam: Gemini AI model selection for processing the edit request.

sessions.title: Conversation Session Management (CRUD /api/sessions)
sessions.desc: Manage chat history, user messages, and generated images with encrypted multi-tenant data isolation in MongoDB.
sessions.listDesc: Retrieve all active conversation sessions for the authenticated user or guest.
sessions.createDesc: Create a new conversation session with type 'generate' (Text-to-Image) or 'edit' (Image-to-Image).
sessions.detailDesc: Get full session metadata along with chronological messages and image attachments.
sessions.deleteDesc: Permanently delete a session and all its associated message records.

usage.title: Quota Status & Usage History (GET /api/account/usage)
usage.desc: Fetch live daily quota metrics, remaining requests, percentage used, and 7-day usage audit logs.
usage.authNote: Returns IP-based guest quota if unauthenticated, or complete account profile quota if token is provided.

plan.title: Subscription Plan Management (POST /api/account/plan)
plan.desc: Upgrade or switch account plan tier instantly (Free: 20 req/day, Pro: 100 req/day, Ultra: 1,000 req/day).

keys.title: API Key Management (GET & POST /api/account/keys)
keys.desc: Create and revoke secure API Keys for external integrations (n8n, Antigravity Agent, OpenCode, cURL, backend scripts).
keys.createDesc: Create a new API Key (body: { "name": "Key Name" }). Raw key is only shown once upon creation.
keys.listDesc: Retrieve all active API Keys with creation and last used timestamps.
keys.revokeDesc: Revoke and destroy the API Key immediately.

status.title: Browser Tab Pool Worker Status (GET /api/status)
status.desc: Check real-time health of Playwright persistent context: busy worker tabs, idle warm tabs, and task queue length.

responses.title: Status Codes & Error Response Schemas
responses.successDesc: Request successfully processed. Returns output image URLs, dimensions, and updated quota info.
responses.error400: 400 Bad Request: Malformed JSON, empty prompt, image size over 50MB, or invalid parameters.
responses.error401: 401 Unauthorized: Missing, invalid, or revoked API Key.
responses.error403: 403 Forbidden: Daily request quota exhausted or feature restricted on current plan tier.
responses.error404: 404 Not Found: Requested session or API Key not found in database.
responses.error500: 500 Internal Error: Browser automation or network timeout (automatic quota rollback guaranteed).
